data.sadPayRule: Military Law sec. 210(1): for each day or part thereof of state active duty ordered under secs. 6 and 7, the same pay and allowances as members of the U.S. armed forces of corresponding grade, rating and length of service, or $125 per day, whichever is greater.
data.federalEquivalentDailyConversion: Monthly federal rate / 30 per day. DMNA's actual daily conversion method was not published in the sources retrieved; treated as an assumption.
data.ordersAuthorityForNySubtraction: NY subtraction S-126 covers SAD orders issued under Military Law sec. 6.1 (governor's order for invasion, disaster, insurrection, riot, breach of the peace, or imminent danger).

specialDutyBonus.officialWording: State government officials committed to providing military personnel working in the prisons with a $2,000 special duty bonus every two weeks, on top of their regular state active duty pay and allowances.
specialDutyBonus.officialSource: DMNA 2025 Annual Report (Support to the Department of Corrections and Community Supervision; Task Force Sentinel)

verified.existenceAndAmount: Corroborated by DMNA 2025 Annual Report for personnel working in the prisons (Task Force Sentinel). Not a universal SAD benefit.
verified.eligibility: Partially verified: 'military personnel working in the prisons'. Individual eligibility depends on orders and assignment; not verifiable here.
verified.effectiveDates: Not verified. The report places the commitment around the transition to a volunteer force by April 1, 2025, and says 2,939 personnel were still on duty on December 31, 2025. No start or end date and no payment calendar was found.
verified.federalIncomeTax: Not verified. No federal exclusion identified: compensation is gross income unless excluded, IRS Pub 15 treats bonuses as supplemental wages, and Pub 3 excludes state bonus pay only for combat-zone service.
verified.nyIncomeTax: Not verified. Whether the bonus is 'income received for active service' under S-126 has not been confirmed by DTF or DMNA.
verified.localIncomeTax: Not verified; follows the NY treatment chosen.
verified.payrollTax: Not verified; follows the SAD payroll-tax treatment chosen.

unresolved.sadPayrollTax: Whether Social Security/Medicare apply to NY SAD pay was not resolved from IRS or DMNA sources (state-employer coverage depends on New York's Section 218 agreement and 26 U.S.C. 3121(b)(7)). Needs: DMNA/OSC payroll guidance or the member's SAD pay statement.
unresolved.sadAllowancesFederalTax: 26 U.S.C. 134 / Pub 3 exclude BAH and BAS paid to members of the uniformed services. Whether state-paid SAD allowances qualify was not confirmed. Needs: IRS guidance or DMNA W-2 treatment.
unresolved.sadPaySchedule: DMNA/OSC SAD payroll calendar and lag were not found. Needs: DMNA payroll calendar or the member's pay statements.
unresolved.sadAllowanceRate: Which BAH rate (locality vs. reserve-component/transient) DMNA pays on SAD was not confirmed.
